name: gearshift
description: Persistent background model and reasoning-effort routing for eligible new local Codex subagents.

interface.shortDescription: Local model and reasoning-effort routing for eligible new subagents.
interface.longDescription: Gearshift Desktop recommends a supported model and reasoning effort for eligible new local Codex subagents using your own Decisions API key. Explicit settings and full-history forks stay unchanged. The local helper holds your encrypted credentials; Gearshift Preview provides the hosted control panel. Native coding work stays on your Codex account.
defaultPrompt: Show me what Gearshift has routed so far.
